Today we announced that we have certified Advanced Design System (ADS) Photonic Designer to support Tower Semiconductor’s PH18 silicon photonics process design kits (PDKs). Engineers can now work from schematic through simulation and layout in one environment. Teams already working on high-speed digital and radio frequency (RF) projects in ADS can use Tower processes to design photonic integrated circuits (PICs) or co-design them with electronic circuits in the same tool.
The booth is ready. The technologies are here.
